question: How do I compare with others my age?
title: You and your age group

cells.title: Your usual month against customers of your age
cells.code:
partial = bool(kori.safe_to_save().get("partial_view"))          # pay moves to another bank: only part of the month is visible here

p = kori.peers()
g = p["group"]
def status(r):
    if abs(r["you"] - r["median"]) < 10 or (r.get("diff_pct") is not None and abs(r["diff_pct"]) < 5):
        return "about the same", ""
    if r["median"] <= 0:
        return (eur(r["you"] - r["median"]) + " more"), "neg"
    pc = num(abs(r["diff_pct"]), 0)
    return (pc + "% more") if r["you"] > r["median"] else (pc + "% less"), "neg" if r["you"] > r["median"] else "pos"
rows = []
for r in p["baskets"] + p["categories"]:
    if r["you"] <= 0 and r["median"] <= 0:
        continue
    s, tone = status(r)
    rows.append({"label": r["label"], "you": round(r["you"], 2), "median": round(r["median"], 2), "status": s, "tone": tone,
                 "gap": round(abs(r["you"] - r["median"]), 2), "basket": 1 if r in p["baskets"] else 0})
bas = [r for r in rows if r["basket"]]
cats = sorted([r for r in rows if not r["basket"]], key=lambda r: -r["gap"])
ev = next(r for r in p["baskets"] if r["key"] == "everyday")
evs, _ = status(ev)
evs_say = evs
nums = [x for x in g["label"].replace("+", " ").replace("-", " ").split() if x.isdigit()]
ages = g["label"]
emit("group_size", g["size"], "count", "Customers in your age group")
emit("min_group", g["min_group_size"], "count", "The smallest group ever compared")
emit("ages", ages, "text", "Your age group")
emit("everyday_you", round(ev["you"], 2), "eur_per_month", "Your everyday, a usual month")
emit("everyday_median", round(ev["median"], 2), "eur_per_month", "The middle of your age group, everyday")
emit("top_gap", cats[0]["label"] if cats else ev["label"], "text", "The biggest gap")
emit("top_gap_status", (cats[0]["status"] if cats else evs), "text", "How big the gap is")
table("baskets", bas, "The three baskets against your age group")
table("categories", cats, "Categories against your age group, biggest gap first")

if not partial and g.get("by") == "age" and nums and ev["median"] > 0:
    say(f"Against {g['size']} other customers of the bank {g['label']}, your everyday spending is **{evs_say}**: {eur(ev['you'])} a month, the middle of the group {eur(ev['median'])}.")
